## R.1 COVERED BENEFIT

For a vehicle with rental reimbursement shown on the declarations, we pay reasonable substitute-vehicle rental charges incurred
because of a covered loss, subject to R.2 through R.5. A vehicle without this coverage has no benefit under this form.


## R.2 WHEN ELIGIBILITY BEGINS

(a) If the covered vehicle cannot safely be driven because of the covered loss, eligibility begins when it becomes disabled. (b) If the
covered vehicle remains safely drivable, eligibility begins when it is actually delivered for covered repairs. A scheduled appointment alone
does not establish delivery.


## R.3 WHEN ELIGIBILITY ENDS

Eligibility ends at the earlier of repair completion or exhaustion of the maximum covered days shown on the declarations. This form
addresses repairable vehicles only; a total-loss case requires separate review.


## R.4 LIMITS AND CHARGES

The base rental charge is limited to the daily amount and maximum days shown on the declarations, as modified by an effective
endorsement. Mandatory rental taxes and surcharges are additional to the base daily limit. Fuel, optional products and rental-vehicle
damage charges are excluded. No separate rental deductible applies.


## R.5 EVIDENCE AND OTHER PAYMENTS

Provide the rental agreement, itemized bill, actual repair-delivery date and repair-completion date. Supporting repair records may be
requested. Do not receive duplicate reimbursement for the same expense. A bill is not proof of payment or insurer authorization.

An effective endorsement modifying a specific provision controls that provision; all other terms remain unchanged. The page 2 flowchart
